messages:
maya: thinking out loud — saved views currently default to the last-used model and filter set. curious if we should make defaults runtime-aware so teams get cost/latency friendly presets by default.
ian: yeah, right now ops teams keep asking users to manually switch models for hot routes. painful UX.
deepa: from infra side we can surface a route-level metric: cost_per_1k_tokens and p95_latency. could feed that into a defaulting heuristic.
alex: +1. we can rank models by cost*latency score per-route. simple: score = normalized_cost * 0.6 + normalized_p95 * 0.4.
tia: design question — do we change existing "Save view" flow or add a toggle "Auto-adapt defaults" on team/org saved views?
maya: prefer a toggle per-saved-view so power users can opt out. default for new orgs could be on.
ian: implementation note: runtime-aware defaults need a small API extension — save view metadata should accept a "defaulting_policy": "fixed|runtime_adaptive" and a policy blob.
deepa: careful about telemetry noise. if we auto-switch defaults too often we might confuse dashboards and telemetry baselines. propose cooldown window 24h.
alex: agreed. also tie into quota tiers: if org is on committed dedicated, prefer stable defaults; if on pay-as-you-go, prefer cost-minimizing defaults.
tia: wireframe idea: in the saved view header show a badge "Adaptive defaults on" with a tooltip: "View adapts to route traffic and quota tier — click to lock model/version".
maya: nice. also need an escape hatch: users can pin a model/version to a view to opt out of model switching.
ian: API draft — example payload:
```json
POST /api/v1/saved_views
{
  "name": "Payment flows - latency focused",
  "filters": {"route": "/checkout/*", "model_family": "any"},
  "defaulting_policy": "runtime_adaptive",
  "policy_blob": {"traffic_threshold": 0.6, "cooldown_seconds": 86400, "model_pin_preference": "low_cost_if_under_quota"}
}
```
ian: backend needs to evaluate at read-time: pick a model variant given recent 1h window metrics and org quota context. small cache to avoid per-request recompute.
deepa: rollout plan: flag behind org-level feature flag. start with non-prod orgs, then canaries, then all. rollout-bot: starting canary rollout for feature flag "adaptive_saved_views" to 10% orgs now.
rollout-bot: canary rollout: 10% -> monitoring 2h -> expand if errors < 0.1% and no telemetry regressions.
alex: telemetry we should capture: how often defaults change, how often users pin after change, delta in avg token cost and p95 for routes where adaptive was enabled.
tia: add a tiny CTA in UI after a change: "Adaptive default suggested X minutes ago — lock this model" so users learn control.
maya: docs TODO: explain policy_blob keys and examples. add migration note for existing saved views (they stay fixed unless org opts in).
ian: infra TODOs: evaluation service, cache, stable API contract. eng-runtime: can we use existing routing policy hooks?
deepa: yes, reuse routing policy service — just need a read-only endpoint to query recommended model for a view given route+org.
alex: also surface an analytics card: "If enabled, estimated monthly saving: $Y" computed from recent 30d traffic. helps sales/enterprise.
maya: action items: ian to spec API + compat, deepa infra design, alex telemetry metrics, tia wireframes, i'll draft docs and rollout plan.
ian: assigning followups in linear. will post PR link when proto API ready.
maya: awesome — small next step: quick spike to compute recommendation for one route and render in UI mock. who volunteers?
ian: i'll do the spike with alex.
ninth: thanks all :rocket:
